messages.subject: Getting Standarized Parameter estimates from an OUT(Mplus)
parts:
I'm trying to plot Standarized Parameter Estimates from an OUT (from Mplus). I can get the model but without the parameters and it appears the following message:

Warning message:
In qgraph(Edgelist, labels = nLab, bidirectional = Bidir, directed = Directed,  :
  Non-finite weights are omitted


And Im using the following Sintaxis: 

outfile <- "BRSQ.out"
semPaths(outfile, what="stand", rotation=4)


Could someone give me some help?

Thank you in advance.

Hi,

Thank you for sending this.  It seems to be a problem with the standardized estimates, but I am not sure why.  MplusAutomation reads the model correctly, apparently, both the raw and standardized estimates.  semPaths() works well for unstandardized, but not the standardized results.  I am copying Sacha Epskamp who developed the semPlot package on this.

Cheers,

Josh



library(MplusAutomation) # using devel version from github
library(texreg)
library(semPlot)

m <- readModels("BRSQ.out")
screenreg(list(
  Raw = extract(m, type = 'un'), 
  STDYX = extract(m, type = 'stdyx')), 
single.row=TRUE)
